build_grpcio_tests_package: build the grpcio-tests package using setuptools with all custom commands and dependencies
run_preprocess_gather_protos: run the preprocess command to gather proto files before packaging grpcio-tests
run_test_lite: run the test_lite command to execute the lite test suite for grpcio-tests
run_test_gevent: run the test_gevent command to execute gevent compatibility tests for grpcio
run_test_aio: run the test_aio command to execute async IO tests for grpcio
